import React from "react"; import { Container, Row, Col } from "react-bootstrap"; import myImg from "../../Assets/avatar.svg"; import Tilt from "react-parallax-tilt"; import { AiFillGithub, AiOutlineTwitter, AiFillInstagram, } from "react-icons/ai"; import { FaLinkedinIn } from "react-icons/fa"; import { SiGooglescholar } from "react-icons/si"; function Home2() { return (

whoami --introduce

I am a network engineer working on cloud infrastructure — the routing, tunnels, and dataplane systems that move packets between clouds.

I work mostly in Python, Go, C, and shell, with occasional detours into SystemVerilog when curiosity leads below the software stack.

My field of interests are   Network Security, Routing Protocols (BGP, SRv6), {" "} and{" "} Dataplane Engineering,  along with applied{" "} Machine Learning — I have co-authored four peer-reviewed publications on graph neural networks and low-resource NLP.

I like building tools that watch real systems —{" "} BGP hijack detection, packet-capture threat hunting, phishing-infrastructure monitoring  — and proving they work against live data.

show peers

Feel free to establish a session on any of these interfaces

); } export default Home2;
